title: Experts Warn U.S. 'Not Prepared' for Next Pandemic After CDC Cuts
detail: Public health experts issued widespread warnings in early May 2026 that the United States is dangerously unprepared for a future pandemic. The Lancet reported that 80% of CDC's highest positions are vacant, approximately 2,000 CDC staff were fired under the Trump/RFK Jr. administration, and most center directorships remain unfilled — with no permanent CDC director or Surgeon General in place. The alarm was amplified by a concurrent hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship that exposed gaps in the U.S. outbreak response infrastructure. One expert noted: 'If this is a stress test, we failed.'

media.caption: Public health experts warn U.S. pandemic preparedness severely weakened after CDC budget cuts and mass staff firings
